coordinates.note: The GRAND Collaboration's GRANDProto300 first-look paper (arXiv:2307.12769) gives the XiaoDuShan site as E 93.94177 deg, N 40.99434 deg, about 150 km north of Dunhuang city; the ICRC 2025 exposure proceedings (arXiv:2507.06629) give 40.99 N, 93.94 E at about 1200 m above sea level. This replaces an earlier city-level point (Dunhuang city itself). The point is the site, not a surveyed antenna position: the 65-antenna stage covers about 30 km2 and the planned 300-antenna stage about 200 km2 (arXiv:2509.21306), so it is marked approximate with a precision of 5 km.
coordinates.quote: the selection of the XiaoDuShan site (E 93.94177◦ , N 40.99434◦ ), situated approximately 150 km north of Dunhuang city

summary.plain: A stretch of the Gobi Desert north of the city of Dunhuang, China, where a prototype array of radio antennas is testing technology for the giant GRAND project.
summary.technical: Gobi Desert site near Xiaodushan, north of Dunhuang, Gansu, China, hosting the GRANDProto300 prototype radio array; coordinates are the XiaoDuShan site position published by the GRAND Collaboration (E 93.94177°, N 40.99434°), not a surveyed antenna position.
